caption: What a gateway for data must do

rows.what: Answer on the same address as the pages
rows.why: The security policy allows a page to ask its own server only.
A sign-in decides who may read, before any data is sent.

rows.what: Keep the data of each customer apart
rows.why: An answer must never contain the data of another customer.

rows.what: Limit how often a reader can ask
rows.why: A limit protects the server and the other readers.

rows.what: Keep a record of every call
rows.why: An auditor asks who read what, and when.

rows.what: Keep every secret on the server
rows.why: A key in the browser is a key that every reader has.

rows.what: Send data in a fixed shape
rows.why: The page checks the data against a schema, and refuses what does not fit.
